chunks: From him, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Fadhl, from Thalabah, from Burayd, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)
That he disliked drinking from silver and from cracked cups, and likewise that one should be anointed in a cracked oil container, and the comb is likewise.
ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq dislike regarding drinking from silver and cracked utensils?
ai.summary: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) expressed dislike (karahat) for drinking from silver vessels and cracked cups, extending this principle to anointing oneself in cracked oil containers and using cracked combs. This narration highlights the Shia jurisprudential emphasis on the physical integrity and aesthetic quality of utensils, linking material condition to ritual purity and dignified conduct in daily life. The inclusion of combs and oil containers broadens the scope beyond mere consumption to encompass personal grooming and hygiene.
